author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been the perfect opportunity for myself and my wife to show her the story of Dragon Ball Super. This time free of all the filler and... admittedly good moments here and there. 

The original Dragon Ball Super wasn't something I felt my wife would have enjoyed and so when this new Beerus remake was announced I made sure that the first time my wife would see this story would be this! Resulting in two entirely different experiences. My own, born from decades of experience with the franchise and hers. One that barely recalls that one time I made her watch Dragon Ball Kai back in 2017. 

This is her first time watching the Battle of Gods Arc
title: I showed MY WIFE Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
